review_scope: WiFi baseband ASIC front-end: spec, fixed-point, microarchitecture, SystemVerilog RTL, lint/CDC/RDC, SVA/formal, VCS/Verdi; boundary at logic synthesis, LEC and front-end ECO; FPGA, embedded, PCB, analog/RF and physical design excluded

grade_contract.A: 可直接抽取並改編為內部 deterministic procedure；仍須 owner 核准與本地 EDA 驗證
grade_contract.B: 可作 supporting procedure；只採用部分方法，不整包安裝
grade_contract.C: 只適合參考；有 project-specific、false-PASS 或工具假設風險
grade_contract.D: 不在 owner scope 或不可接受

runtime_note: 本次只做 pinned source inspection；未執行第三方 skill/script，未在 VCS/Verdi/DC/Formality/LEC 或任何公司 RTL 上取得 runtime proof。NX_CONTEXT=SNAPSHOT_ONLY。

risk: real pynpi tests not executed locally
must not expose license or internal signal names
reviews.decision: 優先改編：保留 runtime/API preflight、同一 clock edge 取樣、coverage denominator 與 JSON evidence contract；不直接複製整包。

evidence: does not equate mapping with equivalence or timing
risk: open-source contract needs mapping to proprietary OA/NX flow
reviews.decision: 優先改編 evidence manifest 與 claim boundary；不要把 OpenADA/Yosys 命令直接帶進現有商用 EDA flow。

risk: Verilator portability is not VCS signoff
reviews.decision: 抽取 testbench checklist 與 timeout/data-integrity 原則；重寫成現有 testbench framework。

risk: Icarus evidence is narrower than VCS
reviews.decision: 只抽取 cycle contract、claim ledger、false-pass audit；不整包安裝。

risk: inferring intent from RTL can reproduce existing bugs
reviews.decision: 只用來產生 candidate properties；每一條需綁 spec requirement 並在正式 formal flow 證明。

risk: blanket false-path guidance can hide real CDC paths
reviews.decision: 只參考 stage inventory；所有 SDC、corner、threshold 與 signoff 規則必須以專案 owner/golden flow 為準。
只採 requirement matrix 格式；禁止把靜態閱讀升格成 satisfied/PASS。

risk: several protocol/SVA examples need syntax and normative review
rigid project policy presented as universal
unbounded properties can hang or pass vacuously
reviews.decision: 只參考檔案分離與命名；不得複製 assertion 範例到產品 RTL。

risk: grep plus $finish is not a truthful PASS gate
reviews.decision: 不要安裝；FSDB 批次分析改採已審查的 x-npi 方法，執行命令由內部 golden flow 提供。

risk: mental re-check instead of actual compile/sim
format compliance can be mistaken for correctness
reviews.decision: 只參考 root-cause grouping/minimal diff；不可授權自動改 RTL 或以 compliance PASS 代表 EDA PASS。

risk: post-layout scope is not current RTL focus
reviews.decision: 只作後段鄰接參考；不納入 RTL 設計 skill bundle。

risk: thin router rather than standalone procedure
reviews.decision: 只參考 wave ordering；不直接引用。

risk: open-source proof does not equal internal formal signoff
reviews.decision: 只參考 proof-stage vocabulary；正式 property、assumption、engine 與 completeness 由內部 formal owner 定義。

reviews.name: review-rtl-architecture
evidence: separates lint, elaboration, function, CDC/RDC, formal and synthesis claims
fail-closed harness rules and signoff:not claimed
risk: v1alpha1 lacks general parameter override and library/waiver provenance roles
OpenADA-specific contract must map to internal filelist/tool evidence
reviews.decision: 優先改編：作為 RTL architecture review 與 evidence-governor 骨架；不複製工具命令，需用真實 parser/lint/VCS/DC/CDC/formal gate 回填。

reviews.name: systemverilog-waveform-debug
dependencies: optional pywellen/fst2vcd and Verilator authority backend
evidence: requires confirmed failing trace or labels relation unconfirmed
discovers actual scopes/signals instead of guessing
bounded probes preserve X/Z and exact bitstrings
one falsifiable hypothesis at a time
risk: VCS/Verdi flow needs an approved FSDB adapter
offline waveform cannot prove simulator scheduling regions
signal names and waveforms are confidential artifacts
reviews.decision: 優先改編方法：provenance、earliest divergence、bounded probe 與 falsifier；必須接真 FSDB/Verdi readback，公開側只保留獲准摘要。

reviews.name: prepare-rtl-for-synth
evidence: requires parser closest to downstream flow
prefers generator options over editing generated RTL
keeps syntax compatibility separate from macro replacement
risk: Yosys/yosys-slang and Chisel emphasis needs commercial-flow mapping
syntax success does not prove semantic equivalence or QoR
reviews.decision: 只採方法、不複製內容：建立 behavior-preserving synth-prep checklist；修改後仍需 VCS/DC/LEC 實證。

reviews.name: hw-cdc
dependencies: configured Questa/SpyGlass/vendor command or repo CDC script
evidence: structural-only review is capped at PARTIAL
requires domain-map delta and per-crossing inventory
risk: no executable proprietary-tool adapter or report schema in this file
structural pattern matching can miss reconvergence and protocol semantics
reviews.decision: 優先抽取 claim boundary 與 crossing inventory schema；真 CDC/RDC tool run 才能升級 PASS。

reviews.name: rtl-quality-reviewer
evidence: review dimensions match front-end failure modes
forbids invented tool results and signoff-readiness claims
risk: pure narrative review with no machine evidence manifest
no fixed-point oracle or requirement-trace schema
reviews.decision: 採用為人工/AI second-pass checklist；外加 requirement ID、evidence path/hash 與 gate status，narrative 不得替代 EDA。

reviews.name: spec-planner
evidence: blocking ambiguity cannot be hidden as an assumption
requires valid-ready fire/stall and reset semantics
risk: default process/tool assumptions must not leak
approval status must be persisted instead of remaining conversational
reviews.decision: 高價值 supporting pattern：抽取 frozen-spec、ambiguity、arithmetic 與 protocol contract，改成 owner-governed intent artifact。

reviews.name: systemverilog-rtl-generator
evidence: requires explicit signedness/width and overflow policy
minimal diff tied to plan/review/tool failure
forbids changing TB to accommodate RTL
risk: AI-generated RTL needs an independent oracle and ECO equivalence evidence
reviews.decision: 可作內部 RTL-authoring guardrail；只在 intent 已凍結後產 candidate patch，接受條件是 compile/sim/lint/LEC 真實證據。

reviews.name: rtl-p3-uarch-policy
risk: fixed SRAM and buffering thresholds are technology-specific
some advisory criteria conflict with final hard-checklist wording
reviews.decision: 只抽取 intent schema、traceability、bit-true BFM gate 與 throughput invariant；不採固定 threshold、命名或 agent topology。

reviews.name: equivalence-check
evidence: missing or unparseable report fails closed
risk: MCP-EDA/Yosys integration is not the internal flow
commercial parsing claim was not runtime-tested
reviews.decision: 優先改編 LEC substance gate schema；用內部 Formality/Conformal canonical report readback 實作，不把 Yosys PASS 升格為產品 ECO signoff。

reviews.name: formal-verification
evidence: property plan maps features to assert/assume/cover
requires counterexample root cause and LEC after ECO
risk: over-broad signoff wording without exact report schemas
assumed-correct shortcut is unacceptable for hard gates
writes repo-local memory and delegates to unavailable orchestrator
reviews.decision: 只採 property/assumption/vacuity/CEX/LEC stage model；刪除 assumed-correct shortcut，所有 PASS 綁定真 formal report 與 owner-approved waiver。

reviews.name: rtl-equivalence-checker
evidence: can organize changed modules and likely semantic deltas
keeps pre-triage separate from authoritative proof
risk: heuristic comparison cannot prove sequential or combinational equivalence
may miss synthesis semantics and state mapping
reviews.decision: 只作 diff pre-triage；不得宣稱等價，也不得取代 Formality/Conformal。

reviews.name: sv-design
evidence: pinned source review exposed a WIDTH>1 2FF synchronizer template
risk: multi-bit CDC through independent 2FF flops can produce incoherent words
reviews.decision: 明確排除：多 bit CDC 範例不安全，不可成為 WiFi ASIC RTL skill 來源。

reviews.name: eco-plan
evidence: scope is explicitly post-P&R spare-cell and metal-only ECO
risk: requires backend authority and physical signoff evidence
reviews.decision: 明確排除：這是 post-P&R physical ECO，不是 RTL／synthesis 邊界內的 frontend ECO。
